RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-male panel is worth questioning as a matter of recruitment process, but it does not establish that sex influenced this decision. Your qualifications look relevant; however, leadership, regulatory experience, and interview performance may legitimately outweigh a higher degree.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment against them, and the applicable panel-composition policy. You can neutrally ask how the bank ensured a fair assessment with an all-male panel.

Stronger warning signs would include inconsistent criteria, sex-related remarks, or departures from recruitment policy. If you suspect discrimination, check local complaint deadlines promptly rather than waiting indefinitely for a reply.
